1. (Currently amended) A method for generating a superframe preamble for a superframe, the superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols, in an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) network, comprising: for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __in a manner that enables concurrent transmission of first broadcast channel data and second broadcast channel data on the same symbol__; and for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel, __wherein the first set of subcarriers and the second set of subcarriers are interleaved or orthogonally separated to avoid interference__.

2. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier __such that the first broadcast channel achieves substantially equal power distribution across the carrier__.

3. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern __that is optimized for channel conditions or system requirements__.

4. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the second set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __in a complementary pattern to the first set of subcarriers to enable simultaneous transmission__.

19. (Currently amended) A superframe generator in a base station in an OFDM network, comprising a preamble generator operable to generate a superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols for a superframe by (i) for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __in a manner that enables concurrent transmission of first broadcast channel data and second broadcast channel data on the same symbol__, and (ii) for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel, __wherein the first set of subcarriers and the second set of subcarriers are interleaved or orthogonally separated to avoid interference__.

20. (Currently amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier __such that the first broadcast channel achieves substantially equal power distribution across the carrier__.

21. (Currently amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern __that is optimized for channel conditions or system requirements__.
